input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.
input.title: Automatic grading lifecycle audit

risks.mitigation: After the required detached checkout, record git rev-parse HEAD in build_result and require the assessor head_sha to match it.
risks.description: The remote-tracking branch can move after analysis, causing builder and assessor to inspect different commits.

risks.mitigation: Preserve the complete test output and actual counts; report skipped database tests as a known issue and do not describe them as passing evidence.
risks.description: The execution lifecycle integration tests require OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL and otherwise register as skipped, so a successful command exit may not exercise T2.

risks.mitigation: Limit assessment findings and acceptance decisions to T1 and T2 while still using the exact PR head commit.
risks.description: PR #791 changes substantially more than the four task files, which creates scope-creep risk during an isolated audit.

body.summary: The specification is implementable against local base b442f99c and target c7e326b7, with no blocking or operator-only decision. The target implements both requested audit subjects and has focused tests. One clarification is warranted: the critical PostgreSQL lifecycle tests are skipped when OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent, and that condition must be reported as a known issue rather than counted as runtime verification.

findings.description: T1 matches the committed model: RunConfig names grading_enabled, parseRunConfig defaults an omitted value to false, rejects non-booleans, and preserves explicit true/false at oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-11 and oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41. Focused coverage is present at oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-75.

The ordered publisher reads the committed run config only for launched events and passes it into the mapper at oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20; the mapper emits the exact committed config or null and refuses malformed committed config at oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-49. Delivery and replay of on, off, and absent config are covered at oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209.

T2 exact-claim fencing is present: the predicate binds claimed status, lease owner, claim attempt, and unexpired database-time lease, while fenced locks the execution row before re-reading that predicate at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-227. Expired, reclaimed, old-attempt, and lock-wait expiry cases are covered at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357.

Completion settles the execution, closes the matching provider attempt, and inserts the grade observation inside the same withTenant transaction at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292. The constraint-failure test verifies rollback leaves both execution completion and answer absent before a valid retry commits both at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244.

The mandated observation test command can exit successfully without exercising the T2 integration tests: observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:21-23 defines integration as test.skip unless OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (or CI is true), and scratchDatabase requires that URL at observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:42-56. The specification already treats an unrunnable test as a known issue, but should explicitly include skipped database integration tests and require their skip status in the recorded output.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly tasks T1 and T2; the development schemas support the requested plan, brief, build_result, PR, and assessment artifacts.
Audit default-off grading_enabled propagation through the committed ordered launch delivery at target commit c7e326b7.
Audit exact-current-claim settlement fencing and transactional completion plus observation append at target commit c7e326b7.

Detach to the existing target ref, make no edits or remote mutations, run the specified observation test command once, report actual output/counts and known issues, and publish the existing PR artifact.
Assess the same recorded head without changes, provide at least one finding per task with file line evidence plus separate test/output evidence, and report the builder test run as test_evidence.

source_spec_refs: T2 settlement-fencing and transactional-append audit scope
Builder checkout, immutability, test, build_result, and existing-PR publication constraints
Assessor same-commit, per-task finding, citation, and test_evidence requirements

proposed_spec_updates.change: After the observation test command requirement, add: If OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent and database integration tests are skipped, preserve the skip information in tests.output/tests.summary and list it as a build_result known issue; do not count skipped tests as runtime evidence for T2.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The repository registers the critical lifecycle suite as skipped without the database URL, so a zero-failure exit alone does not prove the fenced settlement behavior ran.
